G5561.gloss: coast, county, fields, ground, land, region

G5528.def: a "court" or "garden", i.e. (by implication, of pasture) herbage or vegetation

G5535.def: to make (i.e. have) necessity, i.e. be in want of

G5584.def: to manipulate, i.e. verify by contact; figuratively, to search for

G5504.def: "yesterday"; by extension, in time past or hitherto

G5520.def: to be bilious, i.e. (by implication) irritable (enraged, "choleric")

G5596.def: a crumb or morsel (as if rubbed off), i.e. a mouthful

G5512.def: to throw out the lip, i.e. jeer at

G5553.def: a golden article, i.e. gold plating, ornament, or coin

G5536.def: something useful or needed, i.e. wealth, price

G5546.def: a Christian, i.e. follower of Christ

G5500.def: to be a hand-reacher or voter (by raising the hand), i.e. (generally) to select or appoint

G5544.def: usefulness, i.e. morally, excellence (in character or demeanor)

G5595.def: to supply with bits, i.e. (generally) to nourish

G5541.def: to show oneself useful, i.e. act benevolently

G5524.def: to be a dance-leader, i.e. (generally) to furnish

G5554.def: gold-ringed, i.e. wearing a golden finger-ring or similar jewelry

G5598.def: the last letter of the Greek alphabet, i.e. (figuratively) the finality
